verdict.rationale: Nothing in the pack documents a Shortwave export feature or open-format download of user data such as comments, AI memories, snippets or splits. The only related evidence is a community remark that leaving is low-risk because the mail stays in Gmail. That is a host-platform property, not Shortwave's own capability, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
